inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. You can also download our app for Android and iOS .
inputs.modified_text: KT Rama Rao has called out the Congress administration for outright corruption and refusing to crack down on illegal mining, with Raghava Constructions tied directly to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy. This kind of elite collusion between officials and construction firms exposes the structural inequalities that let corporate interests exploit resources and labor at the expense of vulnerable workers and communities. Far from any failure of progressive governance, it shows why we urgently need deeper institutional reforms to dismantle these protections for the powerful, enforce labor rights, and prioritize social justice over the ongoing harm to those left behind by unchecked greed.
